subject: Novafin — MAP draft and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novafin.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Novafin — MAP draft and next steps

Hi Samir — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Per our discovery call, I put together a draft Mutual Action Plan to capture milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. Please find the attached Novafin_MAP_v1.1.xlsx and see a high-level recap below.

Recap (high level)
- Goal: Production inference for customer-facing personalization (6 models initially)
- Proposed target close date: 2027-06-30 (TBD per procurement)
- Key milestones & owners (draft):
  - Agreement/PO signed — Owner: Novafin procurement (Samir + procurement team) — Dependency: SOW and T&Cs
  - Security review / SOC 2 evidence exchange — Owner: Redwood Security (Neha) — Dependency: SOC 2 report + questionnaire
  - SSO & network allowlist — Owner: Novafin IT — Dependency: SAML metadata + firewall rules
  - Pilot / integration kickoff — Owner: Redwood Solutions (Michael) — Target start: 2027-06-01
  - Pilot validation & performance tuning — Owner: Redwood / Novafin eng leads — 2 weeks after kickoff

Open items we need from Novafin to firm up the timeline
- Procurement process & expected PO timing (procurement@novafin.com)
- SOC2 report or permission to provide standard security questionnaire answers
- SAML metadata for SSO and IP allowlist details

Next steps
1) Please review the attached MAP and update any owners/dates inline.
2) If procurement prefers, we can provide a short SOW + standard terms for faster review; Michael can draft.
3) I’ll follow up next week with a checkpoint and an updated MAP.

Attachments: Novafin_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novafin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novafin Procurement <procurement@novafin.com>, Lauren Mills <lauren@consultingpartners.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novafin — MAP draft and next steps

Thanks Marissa — good summary and helpful to see the milestones. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement timing: our fiscal quarter closes mid-June, but the procurement review for new vendors typically pushes to the next cycle. Realistically we should plan for a target close of ~2027-07-15 unless we can accelerate PO approvals. I can confirm with procurement and loop them in.
- Procurement needs: SOW + sample invoice + standard terms (we can accept vendor terms with limited redlines). Please add a procurement milestone with owner and deliverables.
- Security: we will need SOC2 evidence and answers to our security questionnaire before legal clears onboarding. Can Redwood provide a copy of your SOC2 report and a completed questionnaire?
- SSO: We’ll need the exact SAML attributes you require — I’ll ask IT to share.

I’ve CC’d procurement so they have visibility; procurement@novafin.com will coordinate PO timing. Please update the MAP and resend.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Product, Novafin
samir.patel@novafin.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

- Target close date moved to 2027-07-15 (per your guidance)
- Added procurement milestone:
  - Deliverables: SOW, sample invoice, proposed T&Cs
  - Owner: Michael Grant (Redwood) to provide SOW; procurement@novafin.com to confirm PO timing
- Security: attaching link to our SOC2 report and we’ll complete your questionnaire; Neha will own the security packet.
- Dependencies updated: procurement approval, SOC2 evidence, SAML metadata

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
- MAP (v1.2): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-Novafin-MAP

Next steps:
- Michael will draft a short SOW and share by EOD Friday (he’s copied).
- Novafin procurement to confirm expected PO submission date.
- Novafin IT to share SAML metadata for SSO configuration.

Attachments: Novafin_MAP_v1.2.xlsx

If helpful, I can set a 15-minute procurement sync later this week to align on deliverables.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Novafin — MAP draft and weekly checkpoint (overdue items)

Hi Samir / procurement team / all — weekly checkpoint and quick nudge on a few overdue items. I’ve attached Novafin_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (updated dates & procurement line items). Please review and update owners/due dates inline.

Status summary (quick)
- Agreement / PO: pending — procurement needs SOW + sample invoice (Michael to share SOW). Novafin action: confirm expected PO submission date.
- Security packet: in progress — Redwood provided SOC2 link and will complete questionnaire; Novafin action: provide any additional compliance checklist items.
- SSO & allowlist: pending — Novafin IT to provide SAML metadata + IP ranges.
- Pilot kickoff: tentatively scheduled 2027-06-01 but will shift if procurement runs long.

Overdue / blocking items (needs attention)
- Procurement: confirm PO target date (ACTION: procurement@novafin.com) — overdue for confirmation
- Novafin IT: SAML metadata (ACTION: Novafin IT) — requested 13 May, still pending
- Security questionnaire: Novafin to return completed questionnaire items where red-team access details are required (ACTION: Samir / IT)

What I changed in v1.3
- Added explicit procurement milestone with deliverables and proposed dates
- Marked the SSO and security tasks as blockers for kickoff
- Kept target close date 2027-07-15 but noted it is contingent on PO timing

Can you please:
1) Reply with expected PO submission date by EOD Friday 2027-05-21
2) Upload SAML metadata or confirm a time for our teams to exchange details
3) Confirm anyone else who should be added to the MAP as an owner

If it helps, I’m available for a 15-minute sync tomorrow (Wed) at 10:30am PT — I can send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Novafin_MAP_v1.3.xlsx

Thanks for the partnership — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
